title: The flag
logline: Christmas Eve, private. The mailbox with its flag down. Snow, for once. Does Chloe come home: the page doesn't ask; it draws the mailbox.

margin.note: The crab, small, beside the word.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox in rare coastal snow at dusk, flag down, a cap of snow on it, tire tracks in the road going by without stopping. A porch light far back. That's the page.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox in light coastal snow at dusk with its flag down and a cap of snow on top, tire tracks passing in the road, a distant porch light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: December, private. The flag down. Snow.
